name: Suzhou Victory Precision Manufacture Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Victory Precision Manufacture Co., Ltd. engages in the consumer electronics products and automotive parts in China. It offers precision metal structural parts and modules, plastic structural parts and modules, which are used in laptops, televisions, and smart devices; 3C consumer electronics products, such as mobile phones; and optical glass cover plates, composite material display cover plates, and magnesium alloy structural parts, as well as provides in-vehicle central control screens and instrument panel structural components. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Suzhou, China.
